source_crs.name: WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator + NAVD88 height
source_crs.vertical_assumed: --assume-vertical EPSG:5703: the input declares no vertical datum; the user stated its heights are NAVD88 height

transform.name: Inverse of Popular Visualisation Pseudo-Mercator + Inverse of NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) + UTM zone 11N

candidates.name: Inverse of Popular Visualisation Pseudo-Mercator + Inverse of NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) + UTM zone 11N

scale_factors.operation: Inverse of UTM zone 11N + Inverse of NAD83(2011) to NAVD88 height (3)
scale_factors.method: point scale k from proj -V at the extent's centroid (range over its corners); height factor R/(R+h), R the Gaussian mean radius at the centroid's latitude, h the ellipsoidal height of the mean point height; combined = k × R/(R+h); ground = grid / combined

dtm.method: IDW (power 1) of ground points (class 2) within r = 0.707 m of each cell centre

dsm.method: IDW (power 1) of first returns, noise excluded within r = 0.707 m of each cell centre

chm.method: highest value per cell (binned) of HeightAboveGround (hag_nn) of all non-noise points

volumes.sign_convention: above = surface above base (stockpile volume); below = surface below base
volumes.method: per-cell (upper − lower) × cell area, summed separately for positive and negative cells; boundary cells weighted by the fraction inside the polygon (gdal raster zonal-stats --pixels fractional)

zones.name: twin piles
zones.base: least-squares plane through 199 boundary heights: z = 57.854 + 0.01604·(E − 408734.526) + -0.03008·(N − 3772286.010)
